programs.title: Practical Electronic for Industry
programs.description: A training program on "Practical Electronics for Industry" was conducted for 250 students of the Sri Lanka–German Railway Technical Training Center, Ratmalana. The program focused on providing hands-on experience in industrial electronics, aiming to strengthen the participants' practical knowledge and technical skills required for modern industrial environments.

programs.title: Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Journalism
programs.description: AKOFE continues to strengthen local capacity through its knowledge dissemination programs, which aim to empower communities with practical and innovative skills. As part of this initiative, another successful program was conducted for school teachers and students, focusing on the "Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Journalism". The session enhanced participants' understanding of AI tools and their applications in modern media practices, while fostering creativity, critical thinking, and digital literacy among the younger generation.

programs.title: Digital Transformation at Election Department
programs.description: The Digital Transformation at the Department of Elections focuses on modernizing its operations through the integration of ICT solutions to enhance efficiency, transparency, and accessibility. This initiative aims to streamline data management, improve service delivery, and strengthen public trust through secure and technology-driven electoral processes.

programs.title: Vocational Training Institute-Seeduwa
programs.description: A Knowledge Dissemination and Donation Program was conducted at the Vocational Training Institute to enhance technical education and support skill development. The program included interactive training sessions and the donation of essential equipment, aiming to strengthen practical learning and empower trainees with industry-relevant knowledge.
